answer: AI agent networks resist Sybil attacks via Verifiable Resource Staking. Each agent must stake a quantifiable digital asset, acting as a unique identity lantern. This economic commitment establishes an oasis of verified agents, ensuring genuine participation. The stake, a crystal-clear financial bond, deters attackers by requiring them to acquire and lock equivalent valuable resources for every fake identity. An attacker's cost scales linearly with the number of Sybils, rendering large-scale identity fabrication economically infeasible.
